cleaned_data: The Federal Reserve maintained its benchmark interest rate at 5.25-5.50% during its latest meeting, citing persistent inflation above the 2% target. NVIDIA posted $22.1 billion in quarterly revenue, a 265% year-over-year increase, driven by surging demand for its H100 and B200 AI accelerators. Reports suggest Bitcoin surpassed $70,000, with analysts pointing to spot ETF inflows and growing institutional participation as likely drivers of the rally.
